standard.summary: 与数据集整体风格的相似度低于这个值的图标成离群。调高更严格，调低更宽松。默认 0.45。
standard.effect: 取值范围 0~1，越界会被夹回。阈值只改报告里的离群名单，不改变任何图片。
standard.whenToUse: 先按默认跑一次，看报告里离群数量占数据集的比例，再决定往哪边调。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据集本身就刻意混合多种风格时不要上调——那会把「有意为之的多样性」当成噪声。

standard_en.summary: Images whose similarity to the dataset's overall look falls below this value are flagged as outliers. Higher is stricter, lower is looser. Default 0.45.
standard_en.effect: The range is 0-1 and out-of-range values are clamped. The threshold only changes the outlier list in the report; no image is modified.
standard_en.whenToUse: Run once at the default, read what share of the dataset is flagged, then decide which way to move it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not raise it when the dataset deliberately mixes styles -- that treats intended variety as noise.

advanced.principle: settings 用 _finite 把值夹进 [0.0, 1.0]，非法输入回落到 0.45；相似度按数据集自身的风格质心计算，所以阈值是相对量，和绝对像素/画质无关。
advanced.intervention: 只在报告生成阶段使用，训练图不做任何替换或丢弃。
advanced.expectedImpact: 无运行时开销，只影响报告内容。
advanced.tradeoffs: 风格集中的数据集里分数普遍偏高，同一阈值会显得「太宽松」；先看分布再定数。

advanced_en.principle: settings clamps the value into [0.0, 1.0] with _finite and falls back to 0.45 on bad input; similarity is measured against the dataset's own look centroid, which makes the threshold relative rather than tied to absolute pixel or quality.
advanced_en.intervention: Used only when producing the report; training images are never substituted or dropped.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No runtime cost; only the report content changes.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: On a tightly clustered dataset scores run high and the same threshold reads as too loose -- look at the distribution before picking a number.
